note: [L] makes this assembly in Pass.passage: one level-m team serves every admitted input flight, the truncation index is the field Chord.order of the address listing only, outputs satisfy Lives by savory and weighted continuity by Pass.stamped. The cited ingredients are packaged as Chord fields and helper lemmas rather than as one statement.

lemma passage (T:Team (stageP A.B.a (m+1) n)):∃ (Y:Team (stageP A.B.a m n)), Passage H (U:=Y) (T:=T):=by
   have ht U o : ∃ f:Emote,∀ i: Director N m n T, amid f (H.moment i.val).activities U o:= staff g H (fun i j=>prier) (p:=T.val U _) (fun i=>by rw [← (uniformR i).property]; exact (uniformR i).val.property .. )
   choose f hf using ht
   let y : band A.B.a (m+1):= ⟨_,left_mem_Icc.mpr (show A.B.a.clock.hatBeta (m+1)/2 ≤ 2*A.B.a.clock.hatBeta (m+1) from (by linarith [A.B.a.fits.delayed (m+1)]))⟩
   let i':= teacher (0:Home T) (le_trans (b:=(0:ℝ)) (norm_zero).le zero_le_one) H.paid y 0
   have hv t o : amid (f t o) ((0:Show P).proper) t o:=by
     obtain ⟨x,hx,h⟩:= hf t o i'
     exact ⟨⟨_,_,x.reg_site, x.reg_support,x.forced_support,x.forced_inventory,x.forced_tests,fun _ _=> rfl,fun _ _=>rfl⟩,hx,h⟩
   let U:Team (P):= ⟨f,hv⟩
   refine ⟨U,fun i=>?_⟩
   have h:= savory g H i.val|>.valid.labels
   obtain ⟨k,hk⟩:= corresponds U (H.moment i.val).activities rfl rfl h (fun t o=> hf t o _)
   exact ⟨k,hk⟩

proof_context.conclusion: From a level-(m+1) team T, one level-m team U is built that gives a row for H.moment of every admitted input flight (Director) carrying T, using staff with prier (equal address lists).

structure Chord (R:Factor A) (N m n:ℕ) (c c₁:ℝ) where
    paid: m<N
    earns:Roofing R c c₁
    tone : Zeal R.target R.shape A N m
    order : Collection.Listing G (A.B.a.S.side (m+1) n)→ ℕ
    city (u) : Retired R.shape A tone n (1/16) (1/16) u (order u)
    credit (u) : Retired R.shape A tone n c c₁ u (order u)
    towards u: N≤ order u

proof_context.conclusion: The step datum fixes the truncation index as a function `order` of the incoming address listing only, with Retired bounds for each listing.

lemma savory : Lives (Roof.spatial A).bake N m n (H.moment Y):= by
  let F:ℝ→Rep G (A.B.a.S.side (m+1) n):= fun _=> Y.val; have hb:= Roof.coating H.earns.conducts H.paid (R:=F) (s:=Set.univ) (fun x _=>Y.property.2)
  let f:=H.moment Y; have hX:= (gloss H Y).renew g (A.B.support.cap N _ H.paid.le) hb.decent hb.width γ (Return.enough_room _ _ _) (hb.fees 0 (Set.mem_univ 0))
  have hv : f.p=B₀:=rfl; have hr : f.path=A.B.kin.path N m:= congr_fun (congr_fun A.B.bases N) m
  have hk := (hb.closes 0 (Set.mem_univ _) (H.moment Y).activities ((writtenN H Y 0) ▸ hX.gates (A.B.kin.path N m) (A.B.a.params m).clip 0 0)).1 -- infer 0
  refine ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl,⟨?_,?_⟩,trivial⟩; · change PathData.Bounds f.path _ _ _ _; rw [hr]; exact A.B.support.cap _ _ H.paid.le
  exact hk

proof_context.conclusion: The step output H.moment Y of any admitted flight satisfies the stage Lives conditions (path, point, bounds).

lemma stamped {Y}(hY:SectorOn (A:=A) (fun x=>(u x).val) Y) : Rebar (q/2) (phraseS (cho H hp ∘ u)) d ∧
   Rebar q (phraseS (fun x=> Delta H (u x).val)) (chores G (A.B.a.params m) v Ω/(A.B.a.budget m).threshold^2):=by
   have hq':= hq.sphere.2.1; have hy:= qualifiedL g H h hq hY
   obtain ⟨hH,hθ,hE,hK⟩:= hy
   rw [params_eq A.B.valid]
   refine ⟨?_,hθ⟩
   let f(s:sun):Home U:= (chooseR H hp (u s)).val
   refine witness f _ _ (by linarith) (fun w η hw=>?_)
   have hx i: observe U (f i)=(H.moment (u i).val).activities:= (chooseR H hp _).property; simp_rw [← hx] at hE hK
   exact eats f hw ⟨fun w η hv=>hE.stars _ _ (stripe_down hv (by linarith : (0:ℝ)<q/2) (by linarith))⟩ hK (by rfl) (by rfl)

proof_context.conclusion: Along an admitted input family the chosen outputs and the scalar Delta satisfy the Rebar (weighted continuity) bounds.
